project.name: Personal Assistant Growth
project.description: Self-improving AI assistant system that identifies knowledge gaps, creates improvement tasks, implements safe query expansions autonomously, requires admin approval for application changes, and maintains full audit trail with Git-based rollback protection.

inputs: Django email backend configuration in settings.py

Implement test_admin_email_delivery() function that sends a test email.

Run the test manually via Django shell or management command.

Document any email configuration issues encountered.

description.objective: Build a system that recognizes when the assistant cannot answer a user's personal data question and captures the context for improvement.
actions: Create assistant/gap_detector.py file.
Define GapType enum with values: UNKNOWN_DATA_TYPE, MISSING_KEYWORDS, NO_DATA_METHOD, UNSUPPORTED_QUERY_PATTERN.
Implement detect_knowledge_gap() function that analyzes why a query couldn't be answered.
Return dict with gap_detected boolean, gap_type, original_query, detected_intent, suggested_category, and timestamp.
Implement extract_potential_keywords() to identify words that might be new data type indicators.
Implement categorize_gap_severity() returning LOW (keyword addition), MEDIUM (new query method), HIGH (application change).
Add unit tests for various gap scenarios.
description.output: assistant/gap_detector.py with functions that identify and categorize knowledge gaps.

description.objective: Build a service that creates structured improvement tasks in the project management system when gaps are detected.
actions: Create assistant/task_generator.py file.
Define ImprovementTask dataclass with fields: title, description, gap_type, severity, original_query, suggested_fix, code_template, test_requirements, requires_approval, created_at.
Implement generate_improvement_task() function that creates task based on gap type.
For MISSING_KEYWORDS gaps: generate task to add keywords to intent_detector.py.
For NO_DATA_METHOD gaps: generate task to add new method to data_service.py.
For UNSUPPORTED_QUERY_PATTERN gaps: generate task to update date_parser.py or add new pattern.
Implement generate_code_template() that produces the actual code fix as a string.
Implement generate_test_template() that produces mock test code.
Set requires_approval=False for LOW severity, requires_approval=True for MEDIUM and HIGH.
Add unit tests for task generation.
description.output: assistant/task_generator.py that creates detailed improvement tasks with code templates.

description.objective: Create Django model to persist improvement tasks with full lifecycle tracking.
actions: Create or update assistant/models.py file.

Create ImprovementTask model with fields: id (UUID), title, description (JSON), gap_type, severity, original_query, suggested_fix (TextField), code_template (TextField), test_template (TextField), requires_approval (Boolean), status (CharField with choices), created_at, updated_at, approved_at, approved_by, completed_at, error_message, git_commit_before, git_commit_after.
Define STATUS_CHOICES: NEW, PENDING_APPROVAL, APPROVED, IN_PROGRESS, TESTING, COMPLETED, ERROR, ROLLED_BACK.
Add method transition_status() with validation for allowed transitions.
Add method to_dict() for serialization.
Create and run migration.
Add admin registration for manual oversight.
description.output: ImprovementTask model with full lifecycle tracking and admin interface.

description.objective: Build a service that creates Git commits before and after changes, enabling rollback if needed.
actions: Create assistant/git_service.py file.
Import subprocess for Git commands.
Implement GitProtectionService class.
Implement create_snapshot() that stages and commits current state with message format: AUTO-BACKUP Before improvement task {task_id}.
Implement commit_changes() that commits after successful change with message: AUTO-IMPROVE {task_title} (Task {task_id}).
Implement rollback_to_commit() that reverts to a specific commit hash.
Implement get_current_commit_hash() to capture state.
Implement get_file_diff() to show what changed.
Add safety check: refuse to operate if working directory has uncommitted changes.
Add unit tests with mock Git commands.
description.output: assistant/git_service.py with full Git snapshot and rollback capabilities.

Define ALLOWED_FILES list containing intent_detector.py, data_service.py, context_builder.py, date_parser.py.
Define FORBIDDEN_FILES list containing settings.py, models.py, views.py, urls.py, manage.py.
Implement SafeFileModifier class.
Implement validate_target_file() that checks file is in ALLOWED_FILES.
Implement backup_file() that copies original to .backup extension.
Implement validate_python_syntax() using ast.parse() on the modified content.
Implement insert_code_after_pattern() that finds a regex pattern and inserts code after it.
Implement append_to_dict() specifically for adding keywords to dictionaries.
Implement append_method_to_class() for adding new methods to existing classes.
Implement apply_modification() as main entry point with full validation.
Implement restore_from_backup() for immediate rollback.
Add unit tests with temporary files.
description.output: assistant/file_modifier.py with safe, validated file modification capabilities.

description.objective: Build the main orchestrator that executes improvement tasks through the full lifecycle.
actions: Create assistant/executor.py file.
Implement ImprovementExecutor class.
Implement execute_task() as main entry point.
Step 1: Validate task is in APPROVED status (or NEW for low-severity).
Step 2: Update status to IN_PROGRESS.
Step 3: Call GitProtectionService.create_snapshot(), store commit hash.
Step 4: Call SafeFileModifier.apply_modification() with task code_template.
Step 5: Update status to TESTING.
Step 6: Call MockTestRunner.run_single_test() with task test_template.
Step 7a: If tests pass, call GitProtectionService.commit_changes().
Step 7b: If tests pass, update status to COMPLETED, notify admin.
Step 8a: If tests fail, call GitProtectionService.rollback_to_commit().
Step 8b: If tests fail, update status to ERROR with error message, notify admin.
Wrap entire execution in try/except with rollback on any exception.
Add comprehensive logging throughout.
Add integration tests with mock services.
description.output: assistant/executor.py that orchestrates the full improvement lifecycle with safety guarantees.

tasks.name: Create Autonomous Executor for Low-Severity Tasks

description.objective: Build a variant executor that runs automatically for low-risk improvements without approval.
actions: Add to assistant/executor.py.
Implement AutonomousExecutor class extending ImprovementExecutor.
Override execute_task() to skip approval check for LOW severity only.
Add additional validation: task must only modify ALLOWED_FILES.
Add additional validation: code_template must only add keywords or simple patterns.
Implement is_safe_for_autonomous() that inspects code_template for dangerous patterns.
Reject autonomous execution if code contains: import statements, class definitions, database calls, file I/O beyond target.
Always notify admin after autonomous execution.
Add rate limiting: max 5 autonomous improvements per hour.
Add unit tests for safety validations.
description.output: AutonomousExecutor that safely handles low-risk improvements without approval.

tasks.name: Integrate Gap Detection into Assistant Flow

description.objective: Wire gap detection into the main assistant processing to trigger improvement tasks.
actions: Open assistant/views.py.
Import gap_detector, task_generator, and executor modules.
After data query returns empty, call detect_knowledge_gap().
If gap_detected is True, call generate_improvement_task().
Save ImprovementTask to database.
If severity is LOW and is_safe_for_autonomous(), queue for AutonomousExecutor.
If severity is MEDIUM or HIGH, send approval notification to admin.
Continue with original response to user (using fallback general knowledge).
Add logging for all gap detections.
Add user-facing message: I do not have that information yet, but I have noted this for improvement.
Add integration tests for full flow.
description.output: Assistant automatically creates improvement tasks when it encounters knowledge gaps.
